attempts.name: CarryLookaheadExact
attempts.description: 2-layer no-LN transformer: heads gather a_i+b_i per place, MLP computes carries via exact integer threshold sum t_i 10^i >= 10^j, layer-2 MLP selects place by position and applies mod 10, quadratic readout.

attempts.name: GatherThenChainMLP
attempts.description: No-LN; 9-head positional gather attention copies bits/ops to the '=' slot, then 4 ReLU MLPs each compute r_i=op_i(r_{i-1},b_i) via 12 combo-detector units.

attempts.name: date_parser_2L_markers
attempts.description: 2-layer no-LN hand-wired parser: L1 copies prev 4 tokens and detects year/month/day end markers + month trigrams; L2 attends to markers and reads out digits per output position.

attempts.name: date_parser_2L_markers_v2
attempts.description: 2-layer no-LN hand-wired parser: L1 copies prev 4 tokens and detects year/month/day end markers + month trigrams; L2 attends to markers and reads out digits per output position.

attempts.name: DigitGatherStepBits
attempts.description: 1-layer no-LN transformer: 3 attention heads gather digits into N=100a+10b+c; position-gated ReLU step pairs compute bit_(10-pos)(N) as alternating sum of thresholds.

attempts.name: QueryCopyHistRamp
attempts.description: 2-layer no-LN: L1 attn copies query digit to answer positions; L2 attn averages digit one-hots over positions 0-9; L2 MLP selects query bin and decodes count via relu ramps gated by position.

attempts.name: ExactDPGatherMLP
attempts.description: 16-head attention gathers both strings to '=', MLP builds 8x8 match matrix, 30 LN-free MLP layers run the Levenshtein DP per anti-diagonal with exact ReLU mins; quadratic-logit readout.

attempts.name: gcd_divisor_lattice_v1
attempts.description: Attn copies digits; MLP1 builds exact one-hot of a,b via ReLU ramps and sums over multiples to get [d|a],[d|b]; MLP2 ANDs to common divisors; MLP3 picks the common divisor with no common-divisor multiple (=gcd), position-gated digit output.

attempts.name: GatherSlopeIndicatorDecode
attempts.description: No-LN 3-layer: positional attention gathers digits; MLP slope indicators for m=1..5; gated ReLU products give y(xq); hump one-hot decode to tens/ones by position.

attempts.name: MulRemainderGated_v1
attempts.description: float64 LN-free 2-layer transformer: heads gather A (scalar), B digits (one-hot) and generated digits; MLP1 forms R=A*B-prefix via exact ReLU gating; MLP2 counts position-gated thresholds R>=d*10^(9-k); linear unembedding picks the digit.

attempts.name: LexMatchConflict_v1
attempts.description: 3-layer hand-built char transformer: look-back heads build word vectors, exact/hypernym match of hyp words to premise, conflict-category head, cue lexicons; counts -> logits.

attempts.name: LexMatchConflictStem_v2
attempts.description: v1 + stemming layer (strip -s/-ing before premise matching) and extra conflict categories (day/night, old/young, vehicles, sports, instruments, ...).

attempts.name: LexMatchConflictStem_v3
attempts.description: v2 + prepositions/auxiliaries as stopwords and more synonym/hypernym classes (wearing<-clothes, look/watch, talk, photo, hold/carry, perform, eat, ...).

attempts.name: LexMatchConflictStem_v4
attempts.description: v3 + -ed stemming and a final-MLP 'no overlap' feature relu(U - 2*matchedContent) pushing toward contradiction when the hypothesis describes a different scene.

attempts.name: LexMatchConflictStem_v5
attempts.description: v4 + larger hand-written hypothesis cue lexicons (neutral: family/goal/emotion words; entailment: 'at least', instrument; contradiction: frowning).

attempts.name: char4gram_overlap_t035
attempts.description: Hand-wired 3-layer circuit: prev-token heads build char 4-grams, match head (with '|' sink) flags s2 4-grams present in s1, averaging head gives overlap fraction; output 1 if > 0.35.

attempts.name: content4gram_overlap_t030
attempts.description: Same circuit, but averaging head only counts s2 4-grams made of 4 letters (content-word substrings, no spaces); output 1 if fraction found in s1 > 0.30.

attempts.name: prior_always1
attempts.description: Calibration baseline: same overlap circuit with THETA=-1, so the readout always emits '1' (MRPC majority class).

attempts.name: UniformCountParityMLP
attempts.description: LayerNorms removed; layer-1 uniform-attention head counts 1s at the '=' token, a ReLU zigzag MLP maps the count to parity logits; layers 2-3 zeroed.

attempts.name: LexiconNegation_v1
attempts.description: Lookback attention (24 heads) + MLP word detectors for hand-written sentiment lexicon with negation phrases, uniform pooling of polarity, sign -> 0/1.

attempts.name: LexiconStemsContrast_v2
attempts.description: v1 + prefix-stem word detectors and 'but/however' contrast flag (attn+MLP) that upweights later-clause polarity in the final attention pooling.

attempts.name: LexiconExpandedIntens_v3
attempts.description: v2 + expanded hand-written lexicon/stems and intensifier phrases ('very X' -> 1.5x).

attempts.name: LexiconNegFiller_v4
attempts.description: v3 + negation across one filler word ('not a good', "n't very funny"), 28-char lookback, vectorized weight writing.

attempts.name: SPF_ModSumBump_v1
attempts.description: 2-layer no-LN transformer: attention gathers 5 digits; MLP1 tests p|N for 65 primes<=313 via integer bump on sum of digit residues; MLP2 picks first divisor (or copies N if prime).

attempts.name: CountingSort1L
attempts.description: 1-layer no-LN counting sort: attention averages input digit one-hots into cumulative counts; MLP thresholds count vs output index; head picks first crossing.

attempts.name: LexiconVotes_v1
attempts.description: Look-back attention (40 chars) + MLP phrase detectors from a hand-written TREC lexicon casting class votes, pooled by uniform attention; argmax of votes + prior.

attempts.name: LexiconVotes_v2
attempts.description: v1 + expanded hand-written lexicon (auto plurals, more head nouns/prefixes, extra DESC/ENTY/HUM/NUM cue phrases).

attempts.name: PosCopy1L
attempts.description: 1-layer 1-head positional copy: query at answer step j attends to fixed source position SRC[j]; value carries token one-hot, unembedding reads it.
